metadata.title: Carboplatin AUC 4-6 Monotherapy - 28 day
metadata.indication: Adjuvant, advanced or platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian/primary peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer under the source-specific criteria; metastatic breast cancer.

validation.software_test_scope: 302 independent source-derived cases for this protocol pair passed; source-cases-proposed.json. Full-suite integration review is recorded separately.

metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP all-indication source reviewed, with separate q21/q28 count boundaries, renal method and creatinine trend. No automatically chosen AUC or final milligram prescription.

metadata.source_review_schedule: As required from 20 May 2026; version-control update 12 June 2026
audit_limitations: Supplementary HPRA PA2059/032/001 SmPC dated 2 July 2024 supplies safety precautions. Its general labelled dose/count schedule is not silently substituted for the distinct NCCP off-label protocols.
Independent clinical/pharmacy validation and local authorisation remain pending.
The selected AUC, verified renal method, prior dose history and current renal result require consultant/pharmacy verification; this encoding does not select AUC or emit a final milligram dose.
NCCP caps the GFR used in the Calvert calculation at125 mL/min; it does not authorise directly substituting indexed eGFR.
The breast indication is off-label in Ireland and requires local discussion/consent and DTC-equivalent acknowledgement.
The physically rendered q28 count table uses ANC>1 and platelets>100, with <1/<100 delay; equality is not assigned and remains review.

metadata.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC 4–6, selected by the treating consultant, as a Day 1 IV infusion every 28 days; breast/gynaecology treatment continues while beneficial and tolerated.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: NCCP 00251 v6 source reconciled 2026-10-25; independent clinical and oncology pharmacy review pending. Verify the actual AUC, renal method and local plan.
clinical_governance.off_label_note: Metastatic breast use is off-label in Ireland; explain and consent under local policy and confirm DTC or equivalent acknowledgement. No reimbursement approval is inferred from an N/A table entry.

platinum_progression.label: Disease progressed while receiving platinum chemotherapy

ps3_due_to_advanced_gynaecologic_cancer.label: ECOG 3 is caused by advanced ovarian/peritoneal/fallopian tube cancer

gfr.label: Verified GFR / CrCl for carboplatin dosing

renal_input.reason: Continuous renal value supports carboplatin safety review and verified Calvert calculation; do not use indexed eGFR directly.

gfr.assessment_guidance: Use a verified measured GFR, Wright GFR or Cockcroft–Gault CrCl in mL/min. Record the method. NCCP caps the GFR used in the Calvert calculation at 125 mL/min.

target_auc.assessment_guidance: Enter the actual prescribed AUC; the usual range is 4–6. This value does not itself authorise an mg dose or an increase from a previously reduced dose.

other_platinum_hypersensitivity.label: Relevant hypersensitivity to another platinum medicine

extensive_pretreatment.label: Extensive pretreatment meeting the SmPC Calvert warning
extensive_pretreatment.assessment_guidance: Prior mitomycin C, nitrosourea, doxorubicin/cyclophosphamide/cisplatin, a combination of at least 5 agents, or radiotherapy ≥4500 rad (45 Gy) to a 20×20 cm field or more than one field. Confirm treatment records and obtain specialist dose review.

significant_new_hepatic_deterioration.label: Moderate/severe new deterioration in liver tests or liver injury

action.message: Estimated renal dosing requires serum creatinine obtained within 48 hours of administration. Obtain/review a current result and recalculate as required for this cycle.

rules.explanation: Estimated renal dosing requires serum creatinine obtained within 48 hours of administration. Obtain/review a current result and recalculate as required for this cycle.

treatment_phases.name: Breast/gynaecology carboplatin every 28 days
treatment_phases.label: Carboplatin monotherapy · every 28 days
treatment_phases.duration_text: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

administration.dose: AUC 4–6; confirm prescribed target and verified Calvert calculation
administration.notes: Dose in mg = selected AUC × (verified GFR +25); GFR used must not exceed125 mL/min. Do not treat the AUC range as a fixed dose or use indexed eGFR without appropriate verification.

treatment.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC 4–6, selected by the treating consultant, as a Day 1 IV infusion every 28 days; breast/gynaecology treatment continues while beneficial and tolerated.
treatment.dose_formula: Dose (mg) = selected AUC × (verified GFR [mL/min] +25); cap GFR used at 125 mL/min.

baseline: Measured isotopeGFR preferred, otherwise a verified WrightGFR or Cockcroft–Gault estimate
regular: FBC atDay13–15 andDay21 in the first cycles to determine nadir; subsequently before each cycle
Renal and liver profile before each cycle
Neurological evaluation and hearing assessment regularly; greater attention after prior cisplatin/platinum or ototoxic medicines
Estimated renal dosing uses a creatinine result obtained within48hours of treatment; isotope-based dose carry-forward needs a verified ≤110% creatinine trend
monitoring.disease: Response tests and scan interval follow the consultant treatment plan; no fixed CT/echo/DXA schedule is mandated by this regimen.
